reuse.why: Puts the template and hidden rules into the existing shouldWriteMonthActionCategory predicate that every month-wide action already calls.

duplication.why: No new logic is duplicated, but the category+group-hidden query is still written separately in setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg and getBudgetData, and each copy had to be edited to fetch goal_def (redundantly, since c.* already includes it).

placement.why: The rule stays in the shared predicate in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use it.

scope.why: Focused on the request; small noise from the redundant c.goal_def selections, an indentation change in one query and reformatted type in getBudgetData.

maintainability.why: The month-action rule is one function with a single tracking option; the remaining repeated per-action category queries are the weak point a maintainer must keep aligned.

one_place.where: shouldWriteMonthActionCategory in server/budget/actions.ts now decides hidden, group-hidden and goal_def exclusion for copyPreviousMonth, setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg; the includeHidden variation was removed so setZero follows the same rule.
